proposed_widenings.name: replace_damage_type
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's passive weapon rider replaces the existing damage type of a hit made with this specific weapon. The current surface can add damage or modify numeric damage, but it cannot rewrite a weapon hit's damage type from one type to another.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Each time you make an attack roll with this magic weapon and hit, you can have it deal Lightning damage instead of Piercing damage.

proposed_widenings.name: item_return_to_hand_after_resolution
proposed_widenings.justification: The Lightning Bolt property otherwise fits an activated magic-item attack replacement, but the surface has no way to state that the thrown weapon immediately reappears in the wielder's hand after the effect resolves.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Immediately after dealing this damage, the weapon reappears in your hand.

notes: No Dhall/JSON/trace content file was authored. The item fits the existing magic_item kind and mostly fits a composite passive + activation shape, but its passive damage-type replacement needs a new atom, so authoring only the Lightning Bolt property would be misleading.
